architect-system.summary: Design a technical blueprint covering stack, schema, APIs, infrastructure, scaling, and security.

use_when: User asks for system architecture, tech stack, database schema, API design, or deployment plan.
A product or feature needs a durable technical blueprint before implementation.
A major scale, migration, or integration decision needs explicit tradeoffs.
not_when: User journey or screen flow -> map-user-flow.

single_when: Simple product with fewer than three user types and fewer than five data entities.
User supplied stack and only needs a bounded architecture pass.
multi_when: Greenfield or migration blueprint with unclear stack, schema, APIs, deployment, and scaling needs.
Architecture becomes the canonical system record.
Security, compliance, scale, or integration risk is material.
critic_required_when: Writing or updating architecture/system-architecture.md.
Architecture affects auth, data, external dependencies, deployment, or security.
User asks for tradeoff review.

artifacts.produced_when: Architecture reaches DONE or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS.

breakdown-tasks.summary: Decompose a spec or architecture into buildable tasks with acceptance criteria, dependencies, and risk-first implementation order. For AI agents or human engineers.

use_when: Requirements clear (spec or architecture exists); need an execution plan.
Risk-first ordering needed for implementation.
Acceptance criteria + task dependencies needed.

single_when: Small scope (<10 tasks); --fast forces single-pass.
multi_when: Larger initiative with cross-domain dependencies.
critic_required_when: Risk-first ordering check (highest-risk task is not last).
Dependency graph has no cycles.

artifacts.produced_when: Critic PASS; canonical task list for the initiative.

brief-app-preview.summary: Production-ready brief for app onboarding / App Store preview / feature-demo video — UI beats from screenshots, interaction choreography, motion rules, produce-video handoff.

use_when: Screenshots exist and goal is to show a product feature in action.
App Store preview / onboarding video / feature-demo brief needed.
Composition over real UI screenshots (no synthesis).
not_when: No screenshots available; greenfield social video -> brief-shortform.

single_when: --fast collapses to leaner single-pass; safety gates still fire.
multi_when: Default — multi-agent (feature-anchor + crop-map + caption-band + interaction-choreography + critic) with 6 hard gates.
critic_required_when: Always — 6 hard gates (screenshot grounding, interaction vocabulary, mask transforms, pointer fidelity, caption-band geometry, brand-source declaration).

artifacts.produced_when: Critic PASS; main artifact.
Always emitted — per-shot spec for produce-video.
Always emitted — source-ID-to-path map.
Always emitted — crop justifications.

brief-graphic.summary: Produce a graphic-design brief for a single visual asset — social posts, thumbnails, banners, OOH, OG cards. Does NOT render — emits prompt or designer-handoff spec.

use_when: User asks to spec a single visual asset for production.
Image-gen prompt needed (Midjourney / Imagen / DALL·E / Claude Design / Ideogram / Veo / Suno).
Designer-handoff spec needed (Figma, print).
not_when: Brand identity / design system / tokens -> create-brand.
Copy that goes IN the asset -> write-copy.

single_when: --fast collapses Layer 1 parallel into single inline pass + Layer 1.5 to 1 brief + skips Approval Gate 1.
multi_when: Default — Layer 1 parallel (brand-anchor + concept + copy-anchor) → Layer 1.5 brief-synth → Approval Gate 1 → Layer 2 (route-dependent) → Layer 3 critic → Approval Gate 2.
critic_required_when: Always — 8-dim Visual Rubric + 13-pattern Generic-AI-Aesthetic Detector.
Sacred-element compliance gate fires every cycle.

when.if: Hard gate (brand artifacts present) + Cold Start
Platform-aware spec (IG / LinkedIn / FB / YT / X / OOH / banner)

artifacts.produced_when: Approval Gate 2 PASS; default overwrite on re-run.
Approval Gate 2 reject.
Approval Gate 1 stop (paused-candidate exit).

brief-landing-page.summary: Generate a campaign-grade brief for a conversion landing page — hypothesis, architecture, per-section spec, asset slots, hand-off prompts.

use_when: User asks to plan or redesign a conversion landing page.
User needs a designer-ready brief (Claude Design / Figma / human / coding agent).
Post-launch evidence triggers a redesign (Route B).
not_when: Post-launch CRO from real analytics evidence -> evaluate-landing-page (inside run-pipeline).
Page exists but conversion is fine; just needs headline variations -> write-copy.
Non-conversion pages (blog, docs hub, navigation hub) -> out of scope.
Programmatic-SEO templates (industries/:slug, compare/:vs) -> out of scope for v1.

single_when: --fast flag forces single-agent execution per layer (Approval Gates still fire).
multi_when: Default — 9 agents across L1 parallel / L1.5 hypothesis / L2 architecture / L3 section-spec / L3.5 asset-slot / L4 handoff / L5 critic gate.
Route B redesign with evidence anchoring.
Re-run with --rev=N.
critic_required_when: Always — both critics (conversion + brand-voice) PASS-gate every brief before write.
DONE_WITH_CONCERNS is the floor; no silent FAIL outputs.

when.if: Layer 3-4 section spec / handoff prompts / asset slots

artifacts.produced_when: Approval Gate 3 PASS; versioned re-runs to v[N]/brief.md.
Always-emitted companion (universal coding-agent prompt, stack auto-detected).
target_handoff lists claude-design.
target_handoff lists figma.
target_handoff lists designer.

brief-product-ui.summary: Design the in-product interface from a mapped user flow — screen inventory, reusable component system, DESIGN-token application, per-state visual treatments, accessibility floor + buildable handoff. Emits a portable spec, never rendered UI.

Hand a feature's screens to a design tool (Figma / Stitch) or coding agent from a validated flow.
not_when: Flow logic / screen map -> map-user-flow (the prerequisite).

single_when: Single-screen feature; --fast collapses Layer 1 to single-pass.
multi_when: Multi-screen feature with a shared component system across surfaces.
critic_required_when: Always — the 8-checkpoint rubric (flow grounding, token fidelity, state coverage, no-render) gates every run.

when.if: Pre-Dispatch (feature + flow + brand source + target engine)

artifacts.produced_when: Critic PASS (all 8 CPs); UI spec artifact.

brief-shortform.summary: Production-ready short-form video brief — hook, shot list, on-screen text, audio plan, caption, CTA, aspect, length. 1 hero + 2 variants per run. Live-action + motion-graphic.

use_when: User asks to turn a video angle / topic into a shootable brief.

1 hero + per-platform variants requested.
not_when: Organic social copy without video -> write-social.

single_when: --fast collapses to Layer 1 + 1.5 single-pass via single-agent fallback (skips Layer 2 — no critic, no platform-tailor).
multi_when: Default — 9 agents (Layer 1 parallel + Layer 1.5 parallel + Layer 2 sequential).
Multi-platform invocation adds `platform-tailor-agent` for TRUE RECUT variants.
critic_required_when: Always — 4-sub-critic gate (Hook / Production / Algorithm-fit / Brand-fit); all 4 PASS required; max 2 rewrite cycles.

when.if: Pre-Dispatch (Warm / Cold Start, VN auto-routing for polish chain)
Layer dispatch + spawn mechanics + critic routing

artifacts.produced_when: Hero brief — Layer 2 critic PASS / DONE_WITH_CONCERNS.
Per-platform variant (TRUE RECUT) emitted by platform-tailor-agent.

use_when: User wants to build, sign, install, or publish a Swift / SwiftUI iOS app.

user is registering a device or syncing UDIDs with Apple
calling ios-cli endpoints directly or debugging signing-service responses

clean-artifacts.summary: Audit + groom `docs/forsvn/artifacts/` — classify every file (KEEP/STALE/ORPHAN/LEGACY/EPHEMERAL), surface refs + risk. `--apply` archives candidates (moves, never deletes).

use_when: User asks to groom or clean `docs/forsvn/artifacts/`.
Pre-release sweep across pipeline + snapshot artifacts.
Artifact tree feels stale; classification needed before action.
not_when: Cleaning machine state / dotfolders / packages -> clean-machine.

single_when: Always — single-agent orchestrator with built-in critic gate as sub-routine.
--fast collapses orchestration weight but NOT Critical Gates (HARD-NEVER, critic gate, MOVE-not-delete).
multi_when: Never — single-agent skill by design; critic is in-procedure, not a separate dispatch.
critic_required_when: Always — critic spot-checks 5 random STALE/ORPHAN candidates by grepping references before any per-category prompt.
Live reference found → BLOCKED (no confirmation prompt); references surfaced for operator review.

when.if: Runner decision tree (sanity-check, walk, classify, critic gate, build table, dry-run/apply)

artifacts.produced_when: End of run (dry-run or apply); dated, immutable per-run audit record.
`--apply` confirms per-category move; mirrors source path inside dated archive folder.

clean-code.summary: Audit + refactor existing code for readability, maintainability, dead-code removal — without changing behavior. Produces meta/records cleanup record + applies fixes in-place.

use_when: User asks to clean up existing code, remove dead code, improve readability.
AI-slop / over-engineered code needs taming.
Refactor without behavior change.
not_when: Designing a system from scratch -> architect-system.

single_when: Small diff or single-file cleanup; --fast forces single-agent.
multi_when: Multi-file refactor with behavior-preservation gate.
critic_required_when: Always — behavior preservation (test pass + no public API change).

artifacts.produced_when: End of cleanup run; dated immutable record.

clean-machine.summary: Audit + clean a developer's machine — dotfolders, caches, language toolchains, package globals — with per-target risk surfacing and explicit confirmation.

use_when: New laptop setup; need to start clean.
Disk is full or near-full; need to free space.
After trying many AI tools; need to remove abandoned ones.
Before passing the machine to someone else.
not_when: Triaging Documents / Downloads / Desktop user files -> human review, not automation.
Tool ownership unclear AND owning tool can't be identified -> NEEDS_CONTEXT first.

single_when: Operator points at one specific folder; single-target fallback.
--fast flag forces single-agent regardless of scope.
multi_when: Default — 7 agents (dotfolder + runtime + cache + package-inventory scanners parallel; orphan-detection; safe-nuke; critic).
Multi-target cleanup (home / caches / runtimes / packages / all).
critic_required_when: Always — golden-rules compliance + no user-data deletion + no auth surprise.
Bulk-action pause triggers (>10GB reclaim, >5 consecutive rejections).

when.if: Layer 3 safe-nuke / critic-FAIL handling / bulk-action triggers

artifacts.produced_when: End of cleanup session (DONE or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS); dated immutable record.

Refining one tightly-bounded section (taglines only, type system only) with known context.
multi_when: Full brand system across 8 agents (Route B).
Established product, rebrand, or canonical brand-of-record artifact.
critic_required_when: Any BRAND.md, DESIGN.md, CREATIVE-DIRECTION.md, or ASSETS.md write — canonical artifact.
Re-run on top of an existing brand folder.
External-facing identity, design tokens, or platform asset inventory.

Route B completes Layer 2 critic PASS.

debate-agents.summary: Multi-perspective debate panel — spawns 3-5 agents with distinct stances, surfaces tradeoffs, recommends with reasoning. Use for high-stakes decisions with no clear winner.

use_when: Decision is expensive to reverse + 2+ viable approaches with non-obvious tradeoffs.
User wants pressure-test thinking on a strategic / architectural / design choice.
Called as sub-routine by /discover at Step 5.
not_when: Clear best answer from context -> just decide.
Quality check on shipped work -> review-work.

single_when: Never — debate is multi-agent by design (minimum 3 stances).
multi_when: Default — 3-5 agents with distinct stances + synthesis + critic.
critic_required_when: Always — synthesis must surface real disagreements, not collapse to consensus.
Decision summary must name the tradeoff matrix + recommended path + reversibility cost.

artifacts.produced_when: End of debate; dated immutable record with full transcript + synthesis.

design-minigame.summary: Design a marketing mini-game (spin-the-wheel / quiz / scratch-card / playable ad) for engagement or lead capture — mechanic + win condition + honest reward economics + the conversion funnel. Honest by construction, no dark patterns.

use_when: A campaign wants a mini-game / interactive (wheel / quiz / scratch / playable ad) for engagement or lead capture.
not_when: Building the game's code -> engineering (out of this stack).
A static ad/asset -> write-ad / brief-graphic / produce-asset.

multi_when: Default — 3 agents (Mechanic Designer + Reward-and-Funnel + Critic).
critic_required_when: Always — a dark pattern or broken prize economics is a brand + legal risk.

when.if: Anti-pattern review (dark patterns, prize economics, compliance)

artifacts.produced_when: Critic PASS; one game = one spec.

diagnose.summary: Diagnose a business problem or metric decline — hypothesis tree, root-cause analysis, if/then/because reasoning chain, ranked hypotheses with falsifiable tests.

use_when: A metric is underperforming and you need to diagnose root causes.
User asks 'why is X declining' or 'what went wrong'.
Need a hypothesis tree before deciding what to build (Strategy track entry point alongside research-market).
not_when: Know the problem, need solutions -> prioritize.

single_when: Single-metric, narrow scope; --fast forces single-pass.
multi_when: Cross-functional diagnosis (acquisition + activation + retention).
critic_required_when: Always — if/then/because reasoning gate; no unsourced root causes.
Falsifiable test per hypothesis; ranked by impact + confidence.

artifacts.produced_when: Critic PASS; canonical diagnosis record (the current diagnosis of record). On re-run overwrite `docs/forsvn/canonical/research/DIAGNOSE.md` in place and increment the integer version (no `.v[N].md` sibling under canonical/).

discover.summary: Conversational discovery — turn a vague idea, feature, or task into shared clarity through adaptive interviewing. Outputs inline or saved spec.

multi_when: Never — discover does not run multi-agent itself; it invokes /debate-agents as a sub-routine at Step 5 if a decision needs panels.
critic_required_when: Idea-stage mode: idea-critic gate at Step 2.7 (auto-on; skip records override in spec frontmatter).
Saving a spec at Step 7 (review-gated, decision_state defaults to pending).

when.if: Step 1 context gathering / operator-craft stance load
Step 2.6 divergence pass (idea-stage, Deep + open solution space, or operator brainstorm override)
Step 4 conversation — interview techniques + communication discipline
Coverage zone hits data/state, errors, UX, security, performance, integration, business logic, or intent alignment
Step 7 save (operator-grade spec / Light-depth / Contract format)
Resolution-exit edge cases / banned-phrase or false-resolution doubt
